scene: The 26 July run, with the rating vendor answering 'unavailable' for the first part of the night and coming back before the end. The three quoted orders are the ones finance queried on the invoice. The last three are weighed orders: handling_fee takes a rating reservation part way through its body and then reads the fourth line. 5320 and 5323 were filed short of that line; 5326 was filed with it and came off the run priced.
